eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Eagle, CO; at 6:50 AM on AUG 20, 2025 Effective until 7:50 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Public safety officials are issuing a MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER for Sweetwater Rd and sections of Colorado River Rd from Sweetwater to Red Dirt Creek. Derby Mesa Loop remains in pre-evacuation at this time due to a Wildland Fire. Everyone in the impacted area must leave by noon today 8/20.
